answer: A concrete approach: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its ember recurs, its reef survives audit, and a fable from an unlinked peer confirms it.
